facts.fact: The article '4 key things every marketer should know about walled gardens' was published on May 26, 2021.
The article describes Facebook as a walled garden example: through a closed ecosystem, it sells its own inventory while also representing the demand side and controlling the price of its ad slots.
facts.quote: Through a closed ecosystem, Facebook sells its own inventory, while also representing the demand side and controlling the price of its ad slots

facts.fact: The article describes lookalike audiences as taking the attributes of a particular data set (audience) and using those same attributes to target that same group within a closed platform.
facts.quote: Lookalike audiences take the attributes of a particular data set (a.k.a., audience) and use those same attributes to target that same group within the closed platform.

facts.fact: According to the StackAdapt article, programmatic native advertising offers a less expensive cost per impression than paid social, with no specific figures given.
facts.quote: Programmatic native gives you access to a less expensive cost per impression than you’ll find on paid social.
